name: Shopify
symbol: Stricter Liquid parsing for themes
title: Shopify: Stricter Liquid parsing for themes (behavior change)
summary: Starting January 13, 2026, Shopify is enforcing stricter Liquid parsing for all themes
replacement: View the migration guide for detailed information on updating your code.

name: Shopify
symbol: Checkout UI extensions blocking behavior default
title: Shopify: Checkout UI extensions blocking behavior default (new default)
summary: As of January 26, 2026, Checkout UI extensions that support blocking now default to non-blocking behavior
replacement: Merchants must enable the Allow app to block checkout setting in the checkout and accounts editor. Build custom checkout validation using Cart and Checkout Validation Functions instead of Checkout UI extensions.

name: Shopify
symbol: Customer data erasure request processing timing
title: Shopify: Customer data erasure request processing timing (behavior change)
summary: As of March 23, 2026, customer data erasure requests will no longer be held in a pending state for 180 days from the date of the customer's most recent order. Erasure requests will now be processed 10 days after the request was submitted, regardless of when the customer's most recent order was placed

name: Shopify
symbol: Bare query strings for cache busting
title: Shopify: Bare query strings for cache busting (behavior change)
summary: Effective March 24, 2026, bare query strings (a ? followed by a value with no key) will not refresh cached assets
replacement: Use Liquid filters such as asset_url or file_url to generate asset URLs, which add a version parameter automatically.

name: Shopify
symbol: Offline access tokens for new public apps
title: Shopify: Offline access tokens for new public apps (behavior change)
summary: Starting April 1, 2026, all new public apps must request and use expiring offline access tokens
replacement: Implement expiring offline access tokens, which Shopify's app templates and libraries already handle.

name: Shopify
symbol: visibleToStorefrontApi field on metaobject field definitions
title: Shopify: visibleToStorefrontApi field on metaobject field definitions removed
summary: April 2, 2026: visibleToStorefrontApi field on metaobject field definitions will be removed from unstable
replacement: Remove the field from any query or mutation that references it. Storefront visibility is controlled only by the access fields of the metaobject definition itself.

name: Shopify
symbol: CDN URL purge on Shopify-hosted file replacement or deletion
title: Shopify: CDN URL purge on Shopify-hosted file replacement or deletion (behavior change)
summary: As of April 7, 2026, when you replace or delete a file in the Shopify admin, Shopify will no longer proactively purge the file's URL on cdn.shopify.com
replacement: In themes, use the Liquid filters file_url, image_url, and asset_url. In products, insert images and videos via the native Media uploader instead of pasting into descriptions. …

name: Shopify
symbol: Editing and publishing new Shopify Scripts
title: Shopify: Editing and publishing new Shopify Scripts removed
summary: April 15, 2026 - Editing and publishing new Shopify Scripts will no longer be possible
replacement: Shopify Functions, or public apps

name: Shopify
symbol: Automatic bottom padding on body in embedded apps on Shopify Mobile
title: Shopify: Automatic bottom padding on body in embedded apps on Shopify Mobile (behavior change)
summary: These changes will be implemented for all affected apps on April 15th, 2026
replacement: Use var(--shopify-safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) in CSS for custom fixed-bottom elements such as sticky footers or floating action buttons, for example bottom: calc(16px + var(--shopify-safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));

name: Shopify
symbol: CSS delivery for stylesheet tags
title: Shopify: CSS delivery for stylesheet tags (behavior change)
summary: Starting April 20, 2026, Shopify only delivers the CSS from {% stylesheet %} tags that are relevant to the sections, blocks, and snippets rendered on each page

name: Shopify
symbol: Refund processing through original payment processor only
title: Shopify: Refund processing through original payment processor only (behavior change)
summary: This requirement update will be enforced immediately for new app submissions and will take effect on April 22, 2026, for published apps
replacement: If your app issues store credits during a refund, it must use either the 'refundCreate' or 'returnProcess' mutation.

name: Shopify
symbol: Previous Storefront Catalog MCP search and lookup tools
title: Shopify: Previous Storefront Catalog MCP search and lookup tools deprecated
summary: The old versions will be maintained until June 15th, 2026, but all documentation will refer to the latest version
replacement: Use search_catalog, lookup_catalog or get_product at https://{storedomain}/api/ucp/mcp, and update request and response shapes to match UCP.

name: Shopify
symbol: Shopify Scripts
title: Shopify: Shopify Scripts removed
summary: This feature will enable merchants to continue migrating Scripts ahead of the June 30th, 2026 sunset date
replacement: Multiple product discounts on a single cart line, configured through the GraphQL Admin API version 2026-04

name: Shopify
symbol: Shopify Scripts execution
title: Shopify: Shopify Scripts execution removed
summary: June 30, 2026 - All Shopify Scripts will cease to execute entirely
replacement: Shopify Functions, or public apps

name: Shopify
symbol: Shopify CLI 3.83.x and earlier for password protected storefront theme development
title: Shopify: Shopify CLI 3.83.x and earlier for password protected storefront theme development removed
summary: Starting September 23, 2026, Theme commands on Shopify CLI for password protected storefronts will require version 3.84.0 or later. Versions 3.83.x and earlier will no longer be supported for theme development workflows on password protected storefronts
replacement: Upgrade Shopify CLI to version 3.84.0 or later (npm install -g @shopify/cli@latest); or remove password protection from the storefront.

name: Shopify
symbol: Merchant shipping configuration in delivery profile API
title: Shopify: Merchant shipping configuration in delivery profile API (behavior change)
summary: Market-driven shipping will start rolling out to merchants on October 1, 2026, and all merchants will be on it by July 1, 2027
replacement: Markets API for merchant shipping configuration; app delivery profiles keep using the delivery profile API

name: Shopify
symbol: Invalid metafield filters in GraphQL Admin API
title: Shopify: Invalid metafield filters in GraphQL Admin API (behavior change)
summary: API version 2026-10 is scheduled for release on October 1, 2026. Once you make requests on 2026-10 or later, a query that filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering returns an error instead of an empty result
replacement: Confirm each filtered metafield has a definition, the definition allows filtering, and the comparison is supported for the metafield's type; keep affected queries on 2026-07 or earlier until updated.

name: Shopify
symbol: Every existing UI extension on API version 2026-01 or later
title: Shopify: Every existing UI extension on API version 2026-01 or later (configuration change)
summary: To remain deployable after October 1, 2026, an app must ensure that every existing UI extension uses API version 2026-01 or later
replacement: Ensure every existing UI extension uses API version 2026-01 or later

name: Shopify
symbol: Card deposit endpoint requires Shopify-issued mTLS certificate
title: Shopify: Card deposit endpoint requires Shopify-issued mTLS certificate (configuration change)
summary: That deposit call must present a Shopify-issued certificate by October 15, 2026. This is a required change: after enforcement begins, deposit requests will be required to have a valid certificate
replacement: Present a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate on every deposit request to the /sessions endpoint, obtained by requesting one at shopify-mtls-partnerships@shopify.com and rotated via Shopify's Certificate Signing Service before the 1-year TTL expires.

name: Shopify
symbol: Tax calculated on return shipping fees for US orders
title: Shopify: Tax calculated on return shipping fees for US orders (behavior change)
summary: Starting October 23, 2026, Shopify will calculate tax on return shipping fees for orders shipped to the United States on stores that use Shopify Tax or Tax Platform

name: Shopify
symbol: Global Catalog REST API
title: Shopify: Global Catalog REST API removed
summary: The Global Catalog REST API, which was deprecated in April 2026, stops serving traffic on November 2, 2026
replacement: Global Catalog MCP at https://catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp using UCP catalog tools search_catalog, lookup_catalog and get_product

name: Shopify
symbol: Customer data erasure request processing window
title: Shopify: Customer data erasure request processing window (behavior change)
summary: As of November 10, 2026, customer data erasure requests will no longer be held in a pending state for 10 days. Erasure requests will now be processed 5 days after the request was submitted
replacement: Erasure requests will now be processed 5 days after the request was submitted, regardless of when the customer's most recent order was placed. Gift card recipients with scheduled sends remain pending until delivery.

name: Shopify
symbol: IP allowlist required for public apps calling Admin API
title: Shopify: IP allowlist required for public apps calling Admin API (configuration change)
summary: Turn on an IP allowlist by November 20, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET. Apps without one will be delisted from the Shopify App Store and blocked from new installs
replacement: Turn on an IP allowlist

name: Shopify
symbol: IP allowlist for new custom app installs outside your organization
title: Shopify: IP allowlist for new custom app installs outside your organization (configuration change)
summary: Starting November 20, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET: Apps must have an IP allowlist for new installs
replacement: Configure your app's allowed IPs in the Dev Dashboard, using static IPs or CIDR ranges, or ASNs and countries for dynamic egress IPs.

name: Shopify
symbol: Customer authentication in Returns and Subscription apps
title: Shopify: Customer authentication in Returns and Subscription apps (behavior change)
summary: Effective December 1, 2026, Returns and exchanges apps and Subscription apps that provide buyer-facing self-service experiences must authenticate customers using the Customer Account API
replacement: Integrate the Customer Account API for customer authentication in your buyer-facing flows.

name: Shopify
symbol: IP allowlist required for custom apps installed outside organization
title: Shopify: IP allowlist required for custom apps installed outside organization (configuration change)
summary: These apps need an IP allowlist for new installs from November 20, 2026, and for existing installs from January 1, 2027
replacement: Turn on an IP allowlist

name: Shopify
symbol: Non-expiring offline access tokens for public apps
title: Shopify: Non-expiring offline access tokens for public apps deprecated
summary: Starting January 1, 2027, all public apps must use expiring offline access tokens when calling the Admin API. After that date, public apps still using non-expiring tokens will receive authentication errors
replacement: Expiring offline access tokens with automatic rotation, exchanged through code from existing tokens

name: Shopify
symbol: Public app listing and new installs without expiring offline access tokens
title: Shopify: Public app listing and new installs without expiring offline access tokens removed
summary: January 1, 2027: Delisted from the Shopify App Store and blocked from new installs. Existing installs keep working
replacement: Migrate to expiring offline access tokens by January 1, 2027

name: Shopify
symbol: IP allowlist for existing custom app installs outside your organization
title: Shopify: IP allowlist for existing custom app installs outside your organization (configuration change)
summary: Starting January 1, 2027 at 11:59 PM ET: Allowlists are required for existing installs
replacement: Configure your app's allowed IPs in the Dev Dashboard, using static IPs or CIDR ranges, or ASNs and countries for dynamic egress IPs.

name: Shopify
symbol: Public apps with non-expiring tokens in the App Store
title: Shopify: Public apps with non-expiring tokens in the App Store removed
summary: January 1, 2027: Non-compliant apps are delisted from the Shopify App Store and blocked from new installs
replacement: Migrate to expiring offline access tokens to remain listed and accept new installs

name: Shopify
symbol: Merchant warning for apps not migrated to expiring tokens
title: Shopify: Merchant warning for apps not migrated to expiring tokens (behavior change)
summary: January 15, 2027: Merchants using the app see a warning in Shopify admin
replacement: Migrate to expiring offline access tokens

name: Shopify
symbol: Storefront MCP search_shop_policies_and_faqs tool
title: Shopify: Storefront MCP search_shop_policies_and_faqs tool deprecated
summary: The deprecated tool will be maintained until January 15, 2027, but all documentation will refer to Ask MCP
replacement: UCP MCP ask_business tool at https://{shop-domain}/api/ucp/mcp, with the agent profile declaring dev.ucp.common.ask and the question sent in ask.query

name: Shopify
symbol: Script tag injection into storefronts
title: Shopify: Script tag injection into storefronts removed
summary: On March 1, 2027, Shopify will stop injecting script tags into storefronts
replacement: App embed blocks shipped in a theme app extension; web pixels for analytics or conversion scripts

name: Shopify
symbol: Non-expiring offline access tokens
title: Shopify: Non-expiring offline access tokens deprecated
summary: April 1, 2027: Affected Admin API requests using non-expiring offline access tokens return HTTP 403
replacement: Expiring offline access tokens, obtained through token acquisition and refresh handling, or client credentials access

name: Shopify
symbol: Non-expiring offline access tokens for Admin API
title: Shopify: Non-expiring offline access tokens for Admin API removed
summary: April 1, 2027: Admin API requests using non-expiring offline access tokens return HTTP 403
replacement: Expiring offline access tokens

name: Shopify
symbol: Non-expiring Admin API offline access tokens for public apps
title: Shopify: Non-expiring Admin API offline access tokens for public apps (behavior change)
summary: before enforcement begins for existing public apps on April 1, 2027
replacement: Expiring Admin API tokens, following the Admin API token expiry migration guide

name: Shopify
symbol: Built for Shopify App Home visual style
title: Shopify: Built for Shopify App Home visual style deprecated
summary: If your app is part of Built for Shopify, you have until May 1, 2027 to update your embedded App Home interface to match the Shopify admin's visual style
replacement: Use the Polaris 2.0 release candidate (polaris-2.0-rc.js) and update your embedded App Home interface to match the Shopify admin's visual style.

name: Shopify
symbol: Split shipping default for qualified checkouts
title: Shopify: Split shipping default for qualified checkouts (new default)
summary: July 1, 2027: Split shipping is the default for qualified checkouts
replacement: Test any apps, workflows, or integrations that touch delivery, fulfillment, or order logic, especially fulfillment, 3PL, OMS, or ERP integrations that operate at order level.

name: Shopify
symbol: Shipping configuration moved into Markets
title: Shopify: Shipping configuration moved into Markets (behavior change)
summary: July 1, 2027: Market-driven shipping is on for all shops
replacement: Update your app if it reads, creates, or modifies merchant delivery profiles, and make it compatible with market-driven shipping.

name: Shopify
symbol: Ship and pickup in one order for Plus shops
title: Shopify: Ship and pickup in one order for Plus shops (behavior change)
summary: July 1, 2027: Ship and pickup in one order is on for all eligible plus shops
replacement: Test apps, workflows, and integrations that touch delivery, fulfillment, or order logic with this feature enabled.
